zh.title: 國防部偵獲8架次共機與7艘共艦侵擾台海 6架次踰越中線
zh.summary: 國防部表示，自2026年7月28日上午6時至29日上午6時止，國軍共偵獲7艘共艦、1艘中國公務船及8架次共機在台海周邊活動。其中有6架次共機逾越台海中線，侵擾北部及東部空域。國軍已運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統實施嚴密監控與應處。
body: 國防部於2026年7月29日上午發布共機艦動態統計，自7月28日上午6時起至29日上午6時止，國軍於台灣周邊海空域共計偵獲7艘共艦、1艘公務船，以及8架次中共軍機持續活動。
根據國防部公布的動態數據，在偵獲的8架次中共軍機中，共有6架次軍機逾越台灣海峽中線，分別進入台灣北部及東部空域進行侵擾活動。
國防部強調，面對中共機艦在台海周邊的活動，國軍持續運用任務機、任務艦及岸置飛彈系統實施嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: Taiwan Tracks 8 PLA Aircraft and 7 Naval Vessels Around Island
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected eight Chinese military aircraft, seven naval vessels, and one official ship operating around the island between 6:00 a.m. on July 28 and 6:00 a.m. on July 29, 2026. According to official figures, six of the detected aircraft crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering northern and eastern airspace. In response, Taiwan's armed forces deployed mission aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the military activity.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released its daily military tracking report on July 29, 2026, stating that eight Chinese military aircraft, seven naval vessels, and one official ship were detected operating around the island from 6:00 a.m. July 28 to 6:00 a.m. July 29.
Of the eight Chinese aircraft detected during the 24-hour period, six sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering northern and eastern airspace near the island.
Taiwan's armed forces monitored the situation closely and responded by deploying mission aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems, according to the defense ministry.
